copies_policy: one projection result file, stdout normally empty; outside summary contains hashes and counters, no raw projection copy; all added staging/readback copies require prewrite charge
counting_basis: sum current regular-file bytes per distinct governed path; identical SHA/inode remains counted
coverage_limit: Fixed 2776-path original snapshot plus explicitly selected additive JSON/JSONL/hbin paths. New frozen control records and final consumption are outside the snapshot and reserved before creation. Not a whole-machine, remote, deleted, or lifetime-write census.
excluded_development_tools: Go source, compiled helper/worker executables and build caches are separately tracked development tools, not models or serialized scientific data; no RAM or physical-block saving claim.
historical_lifetime_vs_retained_definiti: unspecified in original plan; no lifetime-write total or retroactive compliance claim
scope: explicitly inventoried public short-claim serialized records, corresponding local archived/cache/preparation copies and tiny claim model files; separately report excluded original Laya assets, compiled executables, source/build caches and unrelated experiments
support_records: existing plans, ledgers and source-support JSON in the explicit inventory count; new stage plans, ledgers, result/readback copies count before write
